description:
List US state and Canadian province codes supported by number searches.

        Returns ``regions`` containing ``country_code``, ``code`` and ``name``.
        These codes identify the optional region filter for a city search.
        An upstream failure returns an error.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: list_number_regions

code.description: Two-letter state or province code, such as AZ. Send it as region.
code.title: Code

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2 country code: US or CA.
country_code.title: Country Code

name.description: State or province name, such as Arizona.
name.title: Name

regions.description: Every state and province the number search accepts as region.
regions.title: Regions

title: List number search regions
